note: These are options, not changes. Nothing on this list is implemented until you pick an option and reply with the suggestion ID and letter (for example 'S-03 B'). Each row shows what the site does now, what each option would change, the cost of doing it, and what we would expect it to move. The expected effect is an editorial judgement, not a measured result: this site has no traffic data yet (see /ledger/).

options.label: Keep tagged /dp/ links on the observed products, marked as pending validation (current).
options.tradeoff: Readers can click now; the links are not yet validated in Associates Central.

options.label: Hide all buy buttons until gate G-02 passes.
options.tradeoff: Safer for compliance; the site has no paths to purchase until the owner tests.

options.label: One new guide every two weeks (proposed default).
options.tradeoff: Steady growth; needs a writing slot every two weeks.

options.label: One new guide per week.
options.tradeoff: Faster growth; higher manual load.

options.label: A batch of 10 guides before launch, then monthly.
options.tradeoff: Meets the 'at least 10 posts' rule of thumb (S11) sooner.

suggestions.recommendation: A after measurement is live. Review Search Console query and page performance monthly; choose the next question from reader intent and keep unmeasured ideas labeled as hypotheses.

options.label: Self-host tools/collector.mjs on a small VPS you control, behind HTTPS.
options.tradeoff: Full control of raw data; you run the server.

options.label: Run the collector on a platform that supports Node.js with persistent storage.
options.tradeoff: Less server work; check the platform's data terms.

options.label: Use a third-party privacy-focused analytics product.
options.tradeoff: Quickest setup; a separate processor, so it needs its own disclosure.

options.label: No analytics for now (current).
options.tradeoff: Nothing to maintain; no click or conversion data.

suggestions.recommendation: A or B for on-site events. Use the verified Google Search Console Performance report for search queries and authorized Associates reporting for orders. Those are three different sources.

options.label: Keep the working name 'Affil3' (current).
options.tradeoff: Matches the repository.

options.label: Choose a consumer-facing name and domain.
options.tradeoff: Better recall; needs a domain and a naming check.

options.label: Typography and layout only, no product photos (current).
options.tradeoff: Avoids use of Program Content outside the Associates purpose (S02).

options.label: Original photography of products you own.
options.tradeoff: Strong for reader trust; needs equipment and time.

options.label: Amazon-supplied images through the Associates tools.
options.tradeoff: Allowed only as Program Content on your site; needs review against the IP License.

suggestions.recommendation: B for guides; A for the front page.

options.label: Team byline 'Affil3 editorial team' (current).
options.tradeoff: No invented person.

options.label: Named author with a real bio and a review date.
options.tradeoff: Stronger signal of accountability; needs a real person.

suggestions.recommendation: B once a real reviewer is named.

options.label: Publish the 5 existing guides, then add more on the cadence chosen in S-02 (current).
options.tradeoff: Fewer than the 10-post rule of thumb at launch (FLG-007).

options.label: Hold the site from review until 10 original posts exist.
options.tradeoff: Aligns with S11; delays the tag-based program.

options.label: A gift and holiday-cooking guide hub for November and December 2026.
options.tradeoff: Seasonal relevance; needs a first-party reason to rank it, and no trend data is in hand.

options.label: Evergreen guides only (current).
options.tradeoff: Simpler; no seasonal claims.

suggestions.recommendation: B until measured queries (from S-03) show interest.

options.label: Keep four clusters: air fryers, air fryer ovens, thermometers, unresolved (current).
options.tradeoff: Reflects the five links; the 'unresolved' cluster is a holding area.

options.label: Focus on air fryers and move the thermometer to a supporting note.
options.tradeoff: Tighter topic; drops the thermometer cluster.

suggestions.recommendation: A until the unresolved link is decided.

options.label: Show no prices or ratings (current).
options.tradeoff: No stale or unverified numbers.

options.label: Show dated prices from an authorized source, refreshed on a schedule.
options.tradeoff: Useful to buyers; needs an authorized data source and a refresh process (the Associates tools or PA-API access). Not set up here.

suggestions.recommendation: A now; B only after an authorized source is confirmed.

options.label: No email capture (current).
options.tradeoff: No email data to store.

options.label: Opt-in email list.
options.tradeoff: Direct reach; check the Trademark Guidelines (no Amazon Marks in email, S02) and the Program Policies for email before any Amazon link is sent.

suggestions.recommendation: A until the email rules are reviewed.

options.label: Do not connect Search Console.
options.tradeoff: No search data.

options.label: Verify the site in Search Console and submit the sitemap after deploy (recommended).
options.tradeoff: Needs a Google account owner (Q-12).

suggestions.topic: What the front page leads with

options.label: Lead with the five products in a grid, each with a short reason to pick it.
options.tradeoff: Fastest route to a click; needs product imagery to look like a shop.

options.label: Lead with products, then a 'start here if...' decision strip above them (current).
options.tradeoff: Helps an undecided reader choose a lane; slightly more to read before the first product.

options.label: Lead with the single best-fitting product as a full-width hero.
options.tradeoff: Strongest editorial statement; implies a ranking this site cannot yet justify.

suggestions.recommendation: Keep B until imagery exists, then move to A.
suggestions.evidence: No traffic data yet; reasoning only.

suggestions.topic: Naming the shopper the site is written for

options.label: Write for someone replacing one dead appliance, mid-decision (current).
options.tradeoff: Narrow; the copy assumes a shortlist already exists.

options.label: Write for someone furnishing a first kitchen, who needs the category explained.
options.tradeoff: Bigger audience; needs much more explanatory content to be credible.

options.label: Write for a gift buyer on a deadline.
options.tradeoff: Seasonal spikes; needs price bands, which the site does not publish.

suggestions.recommendation: A now. Revisit after Search Console shows which queries actually arrive (Q-12).

suggestions.topic: How the site earns beyond Amazon

options.label: Amazon Associates only (current).
options.tradeoff: Single revenue source, single set of rules, no extra disclosure needed.

options.label: Add direct-to-brand affiliate programmes for the same products.
options.tradeoff: Usually higher rates; a second disclosure line and separate tracking.

options.label: Add display advertising.
options.tradeoff: Revenue without a click; slows the page and dilutes the shop feel.

suggestions.recommendation: A until the Amazon programme is validated (G-02), then B.
suggestions.evidence: Policy reasoning; no earnings data exists.

suggestions.topic: Whether to keep publishing a second, separate site at /editorial/

options.label: Keep both surfaces (current).
options.tradeoff: Preserves two independent verification passes; splits search signals between two sites for the same products.

options.label: Fold /editorial/ into the root site and redirect it.
options.tradeoff: One site to index and rank, better for SEO; loses the second build's distinct pages.

suggestions.recommendation: B, once the root site covers everything /editorial/ does. Until then, A.
suggestions.evidence: Two sites with the same products compete for the same queries.

options.label: Buyer-question guides in the three existing categories (current).
options.tradeoff: Compounds topical authority; slow to show up.

options.label: Seasonal gift round-ups built from the same five products.
options.tradeoff: Fast seasonal traffic; dates quickly and needs annual rework.

options.label: Nothing new until search data shows what to write.
options.tradeoff: No wasted effort; risks falling below the Associates content rule of thumb (FLG-007).

suggestions.recommendation: A, at two guides a month, until Search Console has 90 days of data.
suggestions.evidence: FLG-007: the site has 5 guides, below the stated 10-post rule of thumb.
